what: A time-window check was exercised only ever by clocks already set to one particular time zone, so a real event that fell outside the window on a different clock went unnoticed by every test that covered it.
rule: Code that judges a date or time window needs at least one test set to a different time zone, not only the zone every other test happens to use.
fix: Enforcement: a shared checklist now calls this out explicitly, and validation warns when a change touching a time-window comparison has no test naming a different zone. Regression coverage is in `tests/field-lessons-batch-p.test.mjs`.
